messages:
Andre: Heads up — we're seeing an error spike on /v1/embeddings after the quant patch. 503s up ~7% over the last 12m. Requesting hotfix deploy and expedited approval. image=registry.redwood/embeddings:20260321-hotfix1

DeployBot: Deploy request received — image=registry.redwood/embeddings:20260321-hotfix1, pipeline=staged -> canary(10%) -> full. CI status: e2e 2/3 (one flaky timeout). To skip canary run `deploybot expedite`. Rollback target: registry.redwood/embeddings:20260317-stable.

Mira: :eyes: What's the rollback criteria? we should only skip canary with clear ops agreement.

Jason: Rollback plan spelled out: revert image to `registry.redwood/embeddings:20260317-stable`, drain new pods, restore KV-cache if needed. Monitor: 200s/latency and error rate. Ops runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings-hotfix

Tara: Security ok — no config or secret changes in this image. :thumbsup:

Andre: Proposed plan: canary=10% for 5m, if error rate <1% ramp to 50% for 10m then 100%. If we need to move faster, request a team pin + expedited full rollout (vote needed).

Leo: +1 to pin and expedite. Customer-facing requests are getting noisy.

Mira: I can monitor logs. I vote to expedite (pin). If anything goes sideways I'll initiate rollback.

Jason: I need a short release note blurb so support has context. Suggested: "Fix embedding tensor ordering for quantized kernels; reduces 503s under load." I'll add to changelog PR.

Andre: Doing `deploybot approve --expedite` now. tagging @Mira @Leo for final nod.

DeployBot: Action: approval recorded (Andre). Expedited deploy: started. Canary set to 10% traffic across 100 canary instances. Tracing enabled and sampling high. Rollback window: 30m. Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/1716854321

Mira: Canary at 10% observed. Error rate initially 2.1% -> trending down. Logs show improved kernel paths in the new image.

Andre: Errors down to 0.6% after ~4m. Ramping to 50% now.

Leo: 50% holding stable. No customer escalations.

Tara: Audit note created: audit-20260321-17. Security log updated.

Mira: Ramping to 100% now; monitoring for next 15m.

Jason: Changelog PR ready: https://git.redwood/changelog/pull/123 — merging after deploy completes.

Andre: :white_check_mark: Full rollout completed at 1716854390. Thanks everyone for quick responses. Follow-up: we'll capture a short postmortem if any downstream regressions show up.

Leo: Thanks all.

Tara: Nice work — saved a bunch of customer calls. :tada:

DeployBot: Deploy completed (1716854321). Canary -> full. Events archived to https://deploys.redwood/logs/1716854321
